evidence.name: Screen field: Add points based on answers
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Add points based on answers" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Add points based on answers
sections.description: Optional and advanced: have each answer on this screen add points to a number variable, like a quiz or lead-qualification score. You can later branch on the total (high score to a premium paywall) or send it to analytics. Skip this unless you're scoring answers, since most screens don't need it.
